description: Turn a garden visit into a practical volunteer field guide using independent site and plant readings followed by a dependent synthesis.

contexts: A volunteer team has separate site and plant observations and needs a short guide.
exclusions: Do not use as a substitute for a safety inspection or local horticultural expertise.
limits: This method does not verify observations beyond the supplied task.

nodes.instructions: Identify access, shade, water, and physical constraints from the site notes. State uncertainty.
Group the observed plants by volunteer maintenance needs. State uncertainty.
Write a concise guide joining the site and plant findings; identify unresolved observations.
